items.title: Should You Buy The Dip In UiPath Stock?
items.summary: UiPath (PATH) is down about a third from its late-August high, including a fall after a DA Davidson downgrade over its AI pricing. A price that much lower can tempt you to buy, but a stock that falls this fast can also keep falling. So should you buy UiPath stock on this drop, or expect further losses.

items.title: CDW's Buyback Pace Jumps: Can Stronger Cash Flow Sustain Returns?
items.summary: CDW accelerated 2026 shareholder returns as buybacks surged, while second-half cash flow hinges on inventory normalization and working-capital improvement.

items.title: ServiceNow (NOW) Stock May Be Fully Priced On AI Security Flaws

items.title: What Is The Case For Waiting On CRM Stock?
items.summary: Salesforce (CRM) stock has gained about 44% over the past three months, while the S&P 500 rose 3.5%. Investors entering at current levels are buying after a substantial run-up. Consequently, the valuation places greater pressure on upcoming earnings to justify recent gains. Have you already missed the move in Salesforce stock.

items.title: Salesforce Is Down Double Digits This Year. Our Model Sees 48% Upside
items.summary: Salesforce shares have shed double digits this year while Wall Street quietly revised its earnings estimates sharply higher, creating a gap between price and fundamentals that few investors are watching closely enough.

items.title: Oracle Jumps 5% as Fusion Claw Launch Adds 25 Agentic Applications; Salesforce Holds Flat, ServiceNow Slips
items.summary: Oracle surged while its two closest agentic AI rivals slid into the red, and the gap comes down to one product launch that claims to change how enterprises run their most critical workflows.

items.title: Palantir's AI Playbook Is Catching On. But Gartner Warns Of A Costly Trap.
items.summary: An innovative AI sales strategy has boosted Palantir stock. But Gartner warns that software rivals may struggle copying the model.

items.title: Salesforce Price Prediction: The Cheapest Way to Own AI Software
items.summary: Salesforce trades at a fraction of what Microsoft and ServiceNow charge for AI growth, and that valuation gap is drawing serious attention. Whether it closes or widens depends on a bet most investors have not fully priced in yet.
